visual.general_description: Three-panel image: a gross photograph of a cut heart specimen and two stained microscopy fields of heart tissue.
visual.detailed_description: A wide image with three side-by-side panels labelled A, B and C. Panel A is a color photograph of a cut reddish-brown heart specimen held in gloved hands beside a tape measure on a blue sheet. Panel B is a pink-stained microscopy field with large areas of round clear fat-cell-like spaces between bands of pink muscle fibres. Panel C is a red-purple and blue stained microscopy field of muscle fibres separated by blue strands, with a few fat-cell-like spaces.

panels.general_description: Photograph of a cut heart specimen held in gloved hands beside a tape measure.
panels.detailed_description: Color photograph of a reddish-brown heart specimen with a cut, glossy cavity surface showing irregular trabecular ridges and pale yellowish tissue along one edge, held by white-gloved fingers over a blue surgical sheet. A flexible tape measure with printed numerals lies along the lower left edge of the specimen, and a bold capital letter A is printed at the lower right. No other printed words are readable.

imaging_modalities.visual_cue: Color photograph of a dissected specimen held in gloved hands on a blue sheet

evidence.quote: The epicardial fat thickness of right ventricle was 4–5 mm and infiltrating into the myocardium (Figure S1(A)).
The epicardial fat thickness of right ventricle was 4–5 mm and infiltrating into the myocardium (Figure S1(A)).

body_parts.visual_cue: Cut cardiac specimen with trabeculated cavity surface held in gloved hands

pixel_observations: Reddish-brown cut heart specimen with trabeculated, glossy inner surface and pale yellowish tissue at one edge.
White-gloved fingers hold the specimen; the background is a blue sheet.
A tape measure with printed numerals runs along the lower left edge of the specimen; no value is read from it.
Bold capital letter A at the lower right.
A cut-off reddish card at the bottom-centre edge of the panel carries blue handwritten characters that are illegible and not transcribed.

caption_claims.value: The text cites Figure S1(A) for the epicardial fat of the right ventricle, 4–5 mm thick and infiltrating into the myocardium

evidence.quote: The epicardial fat thickness of right ventricle was 4–5 mm and infiltrating into the myocardium (Figure S1(A)).

clinical_significance.statement: The case text cites Figure S1(A) for epicardial fat of the right ventricle infiltrating into the myocardium.

evidence.quote: The epicardial fat thickness of right ventricle was 4–5 mm and infiltrating into the myocardium (Figure S1(A)).

limitations: Fat infiltration, its thickness and the right ventricular location are text claims; they are not read from the pixels and no measurement is taken from the tape measure.
A partly visible reddish card with illegible blue handwritten characters at the bottom-centre edge is not read.

panels.general_description: Low-power microscopy of heart tissue with large areas of fat cells between bands of pink muscle.
panels.detailed_description: Pink and white light-microscopy field. Large areas are filled with closely packed round clear adipocyte-like spaces with thin pink walls, interrupted by irregular pink islands and bands of muscle fibres. Denser, more continuous pink muscle fibres run diagonally across the upper right corner. A bold capital letter B is printed at the lower right.

imaging_modalities.visual_cue: Pink-stained thin tissue section viewed under a microscope

imaging_submodalities.visual_cue: Transmitted-light pink and white stained field

body_parts.as_documented: myocardial tissue of the right ventricle

pixel_observations: Large areas of closely packed round clear fat-cell-like spaces with thin pink walls.
Irregular pink islands and bands of muscle fibres lie within and between the fat areas.
Denser continuous pink muscle fibres cross the upper right corner.
Bold capital letter B at the lower right; no scale bar is visible.

caption_claims.value: The text cites Figure S1(B) for haematoxylin and eosin (H&E) histology showing significant replacement of right ventricular myocardium with fibro-fatty tissue

clinical_significance.statement: The case text cites Figure S1(B), an H&E stain, for fibro-fatty replacement of right ventricular myocardium.

limitations: The stain name and the right ventricular site come from the article text, not from the pixels.
No scale bar or magnification is printed.

panels.general_description: Microscopy of heart tissue stained red-purple with blue strands between muscle fibres and a few fat spaces.
panels.detailed_description: Light-microscopy field of tissue with long red-purple muscle fibres running vertically and diagonally, separated by blue-purple strands and patches. A few clear round fat-cell-like spaces lie at the lower left. A bold capital letter C is printed at the lower right.

imaging_modalities.visual_cue: Stained thin tissue section viewed under a microscope

imaging_submodalities.visual_cue: Transmitted-light red-purple and blue stained field

body_parts.as_documented: myocardial tissue of the right ventricle

pixel_observations: Long red-purple muscle fibres separated by blue-purple strands and patches.
A few clear round fat-cell-like spaces at the lower left.
Bold capital letter C at the lower right; no scale bar is visible.

caption_claims.value: The text cites Figure S1(C) for Masson's trichrome staining of the replacement of right ventricular myocardium with fibro-fatty tissue

clinical_significance.statement: The case text cites Figure S1(C), a Masson's trichrome stain, for fibro-fatty replacement of right ventricular myocardium.

limitations: The stain name and the right ventricular site come from the article text; which blue structures are collagen is not read from the pixels.
No scale bar or magnification is printed.

limitations: Patient attribution is left unresolved because the source gives no structural link between the Figure S1 citations and this supplement file; the text cites Figure S1(A), (B) and (C) for the single index patient autopsy findings.
The supplement is cited in the case text as Figure S1(A) to Figure S1(C); the source metadata lists it as a single JPEG without a caption.

Apart from the panel letters and tape-measure numerals, the only text is a partly visible, illegible handwritten label at the bottom-centre edge of panel A; it is not transcribed and no values are read from the tape measure.
